summary: Refactor pricing constants into single config module
description:
PR #40 review surfaced that pricing-related numbers were
hardcoded in three different files with no compile-time link
between them:

  src/lib/spend.ts            usd_limit: 0.17       (= \$5/30)
  src/lib/provider-display.ts questionsPerDay: 30/10/4/4
  scripts/sync-pricing.ts     FALLBACK_PRICING rates

If the cap policy changes (\$5 → \$8/mo, period changes, etc.) all
three drift independently. Comment-as-documentation is the only
link.

Refactor: single pricing-config.ts as the source of truth.

Files:
  - src/lib/pricing-config.ts (new)
      PRO_MONTHLY_USD_TARGET, PERIOD_DAYS,
      PRO_DAILY_USD_CAP (derived),
      FREE_DAILY_QUERY_LIMIT, PRO_DAILY_QUERY_LIMIT,
      TYPICAL_INPUT_TOKENS, TYPICAL_OUTPUT_TOKENS.

  - src/lib/fallback-pricing.ts (new)
      FALLBACK_PRICING + ModelPrice interface, moved out of
      scripts/sync-pricing.ts so client-side code (picker, chat)
      can import it without pulling in pg. Same client-bundle
      hygiene rationale that drove the curated-models.ts split.

  - src/lib/spend.ts
      TIER_LIMITS values now reference pricing-config constants;
      the literal 0.17 disappears.

  - src/lib/provider-display.ts
      questionsPerDay is computed via PRO_DAILY_USD_CAP /
      per-query cost. Hardcoded 30/10/4/4 disappear.

  - scripts/sync-pricing.ts
      Re-exports FALLBACK_PRICING from the new file so existing
      tests that reach for it still resolve.

  - src/__tests__/curated-models-coverage.test.ts
      Imports FALLBACK_PRICING from the new file.
  - src/__tests__/spend.test.ts
      TIER_LIMITS lock-test asserts derived values via
      pricing-config constants, not literal 0.17.
  - src/__tests__/provider-display.test.ts
      questionsPerDay tests check the derivation result, not
      hardcoded numbers.

Done when:
  - Searching for '0.17' in src/ returns nothing.
  - Searching for the literal numbers 30, 10, 4 in
    provider-display.ts returns nothing (or only in test
    fixtures).
  - Bumping PRO_MONTHLY_USD_TARGET in pricing-config.ts is the
    single change required to update both enforcement and
    user-facing labels.
  - Tests + tsc + lint + build clean.

Spec ref: PR #40 review thread.

resolution.note: pricing-config.ts is the single source of truth; spend.ts and provider-display.ts derive from its constants. fallback-pricing.ts split out for client-bundle hygiene (same rationale as curated-models split). 'grep 0.17 src/' returns nothing post-refactor. 246 tests pass.
